data.name: Aabida
data.gender_notes: Aabida is used as a female name in Arabic and Urdu naming tradition.
data.short_meaning: Female worshipper; devout woman; she who worships
data.long_meaning: Aabida (عابدة) is an Arabic name meaning “Female worshipper; devout woman; she who worships”. It is the feminine of Arabic ʿābid (عابد) 'worshipper', from the root ʿ-b-d 'to worship'. The name denotes a woman devoted to worship.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabida carries the meaning Female worshipper; devout woman. The name expresses devotion; this is its documented lexical sense rather than an added doctrinal claim.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabida total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with change, freedom and adaptability. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What does the name Aabida mean?
faq.a: Aabida means Female worshipper; devout woman; she who worships.

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aabida?
What language does the name Aabida come from?
faq.a: Aabida is used in Arabic and Urdu.

faq.q: Is Aabida a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aabida is used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Aabida written in Arabic?
faq.a: Aabida is written عابدة in Arabic, عابدہ in Urdu and आबिदा in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aabida?
faq.a: The root of Aabida is ʿ-b-d (ع-ب-د), from ʿābidah (عابدة).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aabida?
faq.a: Aabida is the feminine of Arabic ʿābid (عابد), worshipper, from the root ʿ-b-d, to worship.

faq.q: Does Aabida appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aabida is not itself a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: What is the masculine form of Aabida?
faq.a: The masculine form is ʿĀbid (عابد), meaning a male worshipper, listed in this dataset as Aabid.

faq.q: Is Aabida a variant of Aabidah?
faq.a: Yes. Aabida and Aabidah are two transliterations of the same Arabic name ʿābidah (عابدة); the final -h is silent in pronunciation.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aabida verified?
faq.a: Yes. The meaning Female worshipper rests on the Arabic feminine active participle ʿābidah, from ʿ-b-d.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aabida?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabida total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is traditionally associated with change, freedom and adaptability. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aabida?
faq.a: Variants and alternative transliterations include Abida, Aabidah and Abidah.

faq.q: Where is the name Aabida used today?
faq.a: Aabida circulates chiefly in Arabic and Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it.
